SMTO-WEB-0042 — The browser you asked for isn't available

GUID: 90aaf790-7edb-5d2c-b370-20dd1414f97c
Slug: research-required-browser-unavailable
Domain: WEB · Subsystem: web_research

What happened

  • You asked SMTO to use the browser, but the computer it's working on can't run the browser right now. SMTO will answer without it and say so, rather than pretend it checked.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Settings › Setup › Gateways and check that the Gateway (the helper program on the computer SMTO works on) is switched on and connected. The browser runs on that computer, so SMTO can't use it while that computer is offline.
  2. If you don't need the browser for this question, send a message saying "don't use the browser". SMTO then answers from ordinary web reads instead of waiting for a browser it can't open.
  3. Ask the person who manages SMTO to make sure the browser is installed and turned on for that Gateway. If the browser parts are missing there, SMTO can't open pages with it no matter what you approve.

What success looks like

  • In your next request, SMTO's activity shows a browser step, or its answer clearly says the browser check was skipped.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, mentioning which computer the conversation uses. Don't rely on the answer as browser-checked; it isn't.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The request requires a Browser observation, the Browser skill is registered, but no browser read action (read_page, snapshot or find) is available on the selected Gateway, so the browser requirement is marked blocked (browser_unavailable).

What this means

  • Research action refresh records required Browser access as unavailable when no eligible Browser read action can satisfy the required method. The diagnostic adds no retrieval. Read outcomes and retained receipts determine what evidence is available; an error does not establish the content of an unread source.

Why this can happen

  • Research action refresh records required Browser access as unavailable when no eligible Browser read action can satisfy the required method.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect advertised read capabilities, binding and recorded Browser blockers.

How to fix it

  • runtime.refresh_actions() sets browser_requirement to blocked/browser_unavailable when browser__start is registered but no browser read tool is available. Check browser.status on the selected Gateway (browser_target_capability_missing, GATEWAY_BROWSER_ENABLED, missing Chromium or OS libraries; repair with that Gateway's installer), restart it and refresh capabilities before a new task. Until then report a partial result without claiming Browser verification.
  • Report a partial result with the Browser limitation. Do not claim Browser verification.

Retry and execution caution

  • Report a partial result with the Browser limitation. Do not claim Browser verification.

How to verify the fix

  • An eligible authorized Browser route becomes available or the method limitation is stated in the partial response.

What not to do

  • Do not bypass Browser capability checks or silently claim equivalent Browser evidence.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic adds no retrieval. Read outcomes and retained receipts determine what evidence is available; an error does not establish the content of an unread source.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
